meta.project: Peta Tematik Interaktif Kabupaten Padang Pariaman

product_overview: Peta Tematik Interaktif is a web application for viewing infrastructure points and regional statistics across Padang Pariaman Regency on an interactive map. It also provides a protected admin panel for managing categories, infrastructure records, and statistics with Excel import/export and photo uploads.
core_goals: Browse an interactive public map of infrastructure across Padang Pariaman
Filter map markers by category and territory to narrow the visible data
Search infrastructure by name and view detailed location popups
Review territory-based statistical indicators with charts and summary cards
Manage infrastructure categories, infrastructure records, and statistics from a protected admin panel
Import and export infrastructure and statistics data using Excel files
Upload and associate photos with infrastructure records

features.name: Public Interactive Map
features.description: A public, read-only map experience for exploring infrastructure locations, boundaries, and related statistics across Padang Pariaman.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the map centered on Padang Pariaman -> Toggle one or more categories to display matching markers -> Select a Kecamatan -> Select a Nagari -> Select a Korong -> View the map and statistics update to match the selected territory -> Click a marker -> View the infrastructure popup with name, category, address, photo, and coordinates
Navigate to / -> Type an infrastructure name into search -> Wait for search results to appear -> Choose a result -> See the map fly to the location and the corresponding popup open
Navigate to / -> Switch the basemap between OSM and satellite imagery -> Observe the map background change while markers and overlays remain available
Navigate to / on a mobile device -> Open the filter panel -> Adjust category or territory filters -> Open the statistics panel -> Review the updated charts and summary cards

features.name: Admin Authentication
features.description: A protected login flow for administrators to access the management area.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See redirect to /admin/dashboard
Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill in invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication error message

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: A protected landing page that summarizes total data counts and provides navigation to management sections.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> View summary count cards for infrastructure, statistics, and categories -> Choose a management section to continue
Navigate to /admin -> See redirect to /admin/dashboard -> View the protected admin landing page

features.name: Category Management
features.description: A protected CRUD interface for managing infrastructure category definitions used by the public map and admin forms.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/kategori -> View the list of categories with icon, color, label, value, and usage count -> Open the create form -> Fill in label, value, color, icon, and sort order -> Submit the form -> See the new category appear in the list
Navigate to /admin/kategori -> Choose an existing category to edit -> Update label, value, color, icon, or sort order -> Save the changes -> See the updated category in the list
Navigate to /admin/kategori -> Choose an existing category to delete -> Confirm the deletion -> See the category removed from the list
Navigate to /admin/kategori -> Choose a category that is already used by infrastructure -> Attempt to delete it -> See a deletion error because the category is in use

features.name: Infrastructure Management
features.description: A protected paginated CRUD interface for managing infrastructure records, including filtering, photo handling, and Excel import/export.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/infrastruktur -> View the paginated infrastructure table -> Search or filter by category and territory -> Review the matching records

Navigate to /admin/infrastruktur -> Open the create form -> Fill in name, category, address, coordinates, and territory codes -> Upload a photo or enter a photo URL -> Save the record -> See the new infrastructure entry in the table
Navigate to /admin/infrastruktur -> Open an existing record for editing -> Update the fields, coordinates, or photo details -> Save the changes -> See the updated record in the table
Navigate to /admin/infrastruktur -> Choose a record to delete -> Confirm the deletion -> See the record removed from the list
Navigate to /admin/infrastruktur -> Import an Excel file -> Review the import results with success and failure counts -> Inspect any row-level error messages
Navigate to /admin/infrastruktur -> Export the current filtered data -> Download the Excel file

features.name: Statistics Management
features.description: A protected paginated CRUD interface for managing statistical indicators by territory and year, with Excel import/export support.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/statistik -> View the paginated statistics table -> Filter by territory, year, or indicator -> Review the matching records
Navigate to /admin/statistik -> Open the create form -> Fill in territory codes, indicator name, numeric value, unit, and year -> Save the record -> See the new statistic entry in the table
Navigate to /admin/statistik -> Open an existing record for editing -> Update the territory, indicator, value, unit, or year -> Save the changes -> See the updated record in the table
Navigate to /admin/statistik -> Choose a record to delete -> Confirm the deletion -> See the record removed from the list
Navigate to /admin/statistik -> Import an Excel file -> Review the import results with success and failure counts -> Inspect any row-level error messages
Navigate to /admin/statistik -> Export the current filtered data -> Download the Excel file

routes.description: Public interactive map with infrastructure markers, category filter, territory filter, search, and statistics panel
Admin login page with username/password form
Admin dashboard with summary counts and navigation
Admin category management — CRUD for infrastructure categories
Admin infrastructure management — CRUD, photo upload, Excel import/export
Admin statistics management — CRUD, Excel import/export

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Admin authenticates with username and password to access the protected admin panel. JWT token is stored in localStorage.
user_interactions: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in username field
Fill in password field
Click Masuk (Login) button
See error message on invalid credentials
Redirect to /admin/dashboard on success

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Protected landing page showing summary counts for infrastructure, statistics, and categories with navigation links.
user_interactions: View summary count cards
Click navigation links to management pages

features.name: Admin Category Management
features.description: CRUD interface for infrastructure categories. Create/edit form with value slug, label, emoji icon, hex color, and sort order. Delete is blocked if category is in use.
user_interactions: View list of categories with icon, color, label, value, and usage count
Click Tambah button to open create modal
Fill in label, value (slug), color (hex or preset), icon fields
Submit form to create category
Click edit icon on a category row to open edit modal
Update fields and save
Click delete icon to delete a category
See error if category is in use by infrastructure

features.name: Admin Infrastructure Management
features.description: Paginated CRUD table for infrastructure records. Form includes coordinate input, photo upload (drag-and-drop or URL), and territory code fields. Supports Excel import/export.
user_interactions: View paginated list of infrastructure records
Search and filter by category and territory
Click Tambah button to open create form
Fill in name, category, address, coordinates (lat/lng), territory codes
Upload photo via drag-and-drop or file picker (JPG/PNG/WebP max 5MB)
Or enter photo URL manually
Save new infrastructure record
Click edit icon to update an existing record
Click delete icon and confirm to delete a record
Click Import to upload Excel file and see import results
Click Export to download filtered data as Excel

features.name: Admin Statistics Management
features.description: Paginated CRUD table for statistical indicators per territory and year. Supports Excel import/export.
user_interactions: View paginated list of statistics records
Filter by territory and year
Click Tambah to open create form
Fill in territory codes, indicator name, numeric value, unit, year
Save new statistic record
Click edit icon to update an existing record
Click delete icon and confirm to delete a record
Click Import to upload Excel file and see import results
Click Export to download filtered data as Excel

features.name: Public Interactive Map
features.description: Full-screen Leaflet map with infrastructure markers, OSM/Google Satellite basemap toggle, GeoJSON boundary overlays, category filter, cascading territory filter, debounced search, and statistics panel.
user_interactions: View map centered on Padang Pariaman
Toggle category filters to show/hide markers
Select Kecamatan, Nagari, Korong in cascading dropdowns
Type in search bar to find infrastructure by name
Click search result to fly map to location
Click marker to see popup with name, category, address, photo
Toggle basemap between OSM and Google Satellite
View statistics panel with charts updating per territory
On mobile, open filter and statistics via bottom sheet drawers

known_limitations.issue: Territory names shown as code-based labels (e.g. "Kecamatan 130501") — no proper name lookup table
known_limitations.impact: Filter dropdowns show code-based names instead of real names

known_limitations.issue: No marker clustering — all markers rendered directly
known_limitations.impact: Performance may degrade with large datasets

known_limitations.issue: Single admin account — no multi-user or RBAC support
